podcast.body: Eddie Vedder performed this song on stage with Bruce Springsteen and the E Street Band at a "rock for change event" during a New Jersey show on October 13, 2004, as part of the Vote for Change Tour. "Eddie Vetter singing with Bruce Springsteen and the East Street band at a rock for change event in New Jersey in 2004."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: Eddie wrote "Better Man" in high school; it was played by his pre–Pearl Jam San Diego band Bad Radio as early as 1989. Pearl Jam recorded it for *Vs.* but it was cut; neither Eddie nor the band believed in the song, and they were prepared to donate it to Greenpeace for a benefit compilation. Producer Brendan O'Brien insisted it was a hit. Eddie then offered it to Chrissie Hynde of the Pretenders (who failed to show up to the meeting). O'Brien insisted the band re-record it; they did so twice more and a composite was used on *Vitalogy*, where it became one of their biggest hits — precisely what the band had dreaded. "That would end up becoming a much bigger hit for Pearl Jam about five years later."
